description: Keep your car, bike, SUV, or furniture spotless in minutes — without a single drop of water. The MERAK Car Duster is made from premium wax-treated cotton strands that lift and lock away dust, pollen, and road grit instead of pushing it around like ordinary dusters. Unlike cheaper alternatives, MERAK leaves no wax stains and no loose threads behind — so you get a scratch-free, lint-free finish every single time, safe for clear coats, glass, chrome, and interiors alike. Built with a heavy-duty extendable handle for easy reach on tall vehicles, and paired with a dedicated storage pouch to protect the duster when not in use. Fully washable and re-waxable, the MERAK Duster is designed to perform like new for years — a one-time buy that saves you time, water, and money on every wash. Care Tip: Shake after each use, hand-wash with mild soap and cold water, air-dry in shade, and refresh periodically with paraffin wax for maximum dust-pickup performance.
